H13 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The candidates were chosen by the screen designers on accessibility and H3K27ac, so
every element here is already enhancer-like and these marks are separating
functional from non-functional inside a pre-enriched pool.
H4 is post-hoc on the same pairs and is not evidence. H3 is prospective only in the
sense that it never looks at the label; it was still written after seeing loop 188's
refutation, and a coverage confound found by looking is not the same as one
predicted in advance.
Bulk K562 marks average over a population, so an element Polycomb-marked in half the
cells and acetylated in the other half reads as both.
The me1-minus-me3 contrast mixes RPM with peak signal from a different assay and is
an ordering device, not a physical ratio; the raw columns are entered beside it.
Marks are correlational and nothing here perturbs one.
H5 and H6 separate repression from the category, but neither is independent of the
accessibility columns in loop 185's stack, which is why H11 and not H5 is decisive.
